comments.author: assistant
comments.text:
Found and fixed two latent bugs in modules/nixos/_biapy/boot/zswap.nix while wiring the test:

1. `mergeAttrsList` was merging an `mkIf` wrapper into the module config, so the whole `config` attr was dropped whenever `compressor` was not lz4/lz4hc (the default zstd) — `boot.kernelParams` was never set. Replaced with a plain nested attrs + `optionalAttrs`.

2. `"\${cfg.accept_threshold_percent}"` interpolated an int, which Nix 2.34 rejects ("cannot coerce an integer to a string"). Now uses `builtins.toString`.

The test asserts on the evaluated `boot.kernelParams` because the VM kernel command line is not built from that option.
